scripts.migrate:dev: NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --config src/config/config.js --migrations-path src/migrations
scripts.migrate:prod: NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --config src/config/config.js --migrations-path src/migrations
scripts.seed:prod: NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config src/config/config.js --seeders-path src/seeders
scripts.seed:dev: NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config src/config/config.js  --seeders-path src/seeders
scripts.rollback:dev: NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config src/config/config.js --migrations-path src/migrations
